name: – After § 1 – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: 1b. Recalls and supports the actions of law enforcement agencies and grassroots organisations, both of which contribute to the protection of young people, social cohesion and democratic vitality; recalls that law enforcement agencies and grassroots organisations are often under-recognised, under-supported and under-protected;
